about: The tractus of the formulary “Septuagesima Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Out of the depths I have cried unto Thee, O Lord; Lord, hear my voice. Let Thine ears be attentive to the prayer of Thy servant. If Thou, O Lord, wilt mark iniquities, Lord, who shall stand? But with Thee there is forgiveness, and because of Thy law I have waited for Thee, O Lord.
